steps.say: Joining words link two ideas into one sentence.
steps.show: I like rice and I like noodles.
I have a pen and a ruler.

steps.say: But shows a change or a problem.
steps.show: I wanted to play, but it rained.

steps.say: Because gives a reason. It answers why.
steps.show: I wore a coat because it was cold.

steps.say: So tells you what happened next.
steps.show: It was cold, so I wore a coat.

check.prompt: Choose the joining word. 'I was thirsty, ___ I drank some water.'
check.explanation: So shows a result: I was thirsty, so I drank some water.

options.why: Because gives a reason, but here the reason comes first.

check.prompt: Choose the joining word. 'I stayed at home ___ I was ill.'
hints: Why did I stay at home?
The second part is a reason.
check.explanation: Because gives the reason: I stayed at home because I was ill.

options.why: So would mean being ill was a result of staying home.
And adds more. Here we need a reason.
